description: This file defines an enumeration 'PermissionEffect' representing the possible permission effects (GRANT and REVOKE) used within the policy system of Eclipse Ditto. It provides methods to retrieve the effect's identifier and string representation.

classes.name: PermissionEffect
classes.description: Enumeration of available permission effects (GRANT and REVOKE) with associated identifiers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the string identifier associated with the permission effect.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the permission effect, which is its identifier.
